checks.name: singing and pitched bass entrances retain source time plus exactly one user offset
held singing phrases use actual legal release codes with an independently expected fade slope
separated lane allocation retains every percussion, melody and arrangement byte outside the focused lanes
focus switches change emphasis independently without changing analysis or beat times
legacy instrumental and generic spectral attacks never become fabricated vocal or pitched-bass events
uncertain role evidence and unavailable singing detection fall back to the intact full arrangement
long sung regions use sparse confidence-gated contours without creating a syllable clock
vocal and bass phrase movement targets preserve non-grid timing while respecting travel, recovery and budgets
high note density never creates rapid motor commands or breaks output masks and manual ownership
role-aware composition remains deterministic and all lights obey actual silent regions

limitations: Fixtures validate scheduling and exported commands for declared event times; source-classification and bass-estimation accuracy need separate audio evaluation.
Singing contours are sparse mixture estimates within classified singing, not lyrics or isolated vocal-note transcription.
Actuator travel and Dance trajectories are vehicle estimates, not measurements from a connected car.
